capabilities: Sync vault files to a private GitHub repository
Clone a repository into an empty vault on another device
Resolve same-file conflicts with a side-by-side modal
Trigger syncs on edit, startup, focus and a timer
disambiguation: Not a Git client or repository browser; it syncs the whole vault to one chosen GitHub repository.
extras: Free; needs Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; GitHub repositories have a soft limit of about 1 GB; the access token is stored in local plugin data and never synced.
intentEvidence: Does this replace Obsidian Sync? It is an alternative, not a companion.
problem: Keeping notes in step across desktop and mobile normally needs a paid sync service or manual Git commands.

relations.evidence: It is an alternative, not a companion. Running both at once is not recommended.
Install the BRAT plugin from Community plugins.

summary: Syncs the whole vault to a private GitHub repository you choose, with automatic pushes, pulls and a conflict-resolution modal.
